title: Neon tube macro triptych
summary: Three hard-cut macro views of one glowing tube on black: a bent corner, a level band with light sliding along it, a forked joint. A slow creep keeps each hold alive; a vertical mood loop or backdrop for type.
use_when: A vertical teaser or story background before the product or a line of type appears
Brands with a single saturated accent colour that can carry a whole frame
Silent autoplay openers where a 6 s abstract hold is enough
A backplate behind a short statement or logo added on top

sfx.event: first frame, the lit tube corner is already on
hard cut to a new macro view of the tube (2.17 s, 4.13 s)

structure.shot: macro of a bent neon tube: diagonal from top-left, rounded corner, then almost vertical down to the bottom edge; white core, wide green falloff
structure.camera: near static drift: ~0.1 % frame diff/s, pan ~2 px/fr @1920, zoom within ±1.5 %/s (motion.json; not visible on the 4 fps sheets)
structure.motion: no element motion; tube fully lit from frame 0; glow holds constant across 9 cells (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a level glowing band across the full width at about half height, two bright edge lines, haze above and below
structure.camera: static framing on the band (band stays at ~50 % H in every cell); motion.json reports ~+10 %/s zoom on the haze, not visible on the sheets
structure.motion: light travels along the band: from ~3.50 s the right end dims and a darker gradient moves leftwards, easings.linear ~19 fr (±0.25 s); estimated lateral flow ~46 px/fr @1920 (motion.json second 3)

structure.shot: macro of a forked tube joint: thick green body from the left, one arm up-left, one arm to the right, one arm down; dark inner corner
structure.camera: push-in, slow creep ~1.00→1.03 over 65 fr (suggested; motion.json 6-10 %/s, sheets show < 2 % change at 0.25 s resolution)
structure.motion: no element motion; joint lit from the cut frame; slight darkening of the body towards the end (6.00-6.27 s cells)

params.brand: brand.json: accent paints the tube glow, bg is the black field
params.shots: 3 tube shapes (corner, band, fork), each ~2 s (65/59/65 fr @30)
params.glow: falloff width of the halo in % of frame width (reference ~12 %, suggested)
params.travel: speed of the light sliding along the band in shot 2 (suggested ~45 px/fr @1920)

notes: Silent reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Three shots cut hard at 2.17 s (f65) and 4.13 s (f124). No text, no logo: the film is pure light. Camera numbers come from motion.json block matching, not from the sheets, where frames look almost identical within a shot; treat drift and push values as suggested. Proposed term (not in vocabulary): neon-tube = stroked path with a white core and a wide accent falloff.
